::: {.callout-warning}
`KPEX` is experimental. Extraction and consistency checks do not establish calibrated accuracy for every device or layout.
:::

| Engine | PEX mode | Status | What it produces |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `KPEX/MAGIC` | `CC`, `R`, `RC` | Available | Extraction through an installed `magic` executable |
| `KPEX/FasterCap` | `CC` | Available, validation ongoing | Capacitance matrix from a field solver |
| `KPEX/FastCap2` | `CC` | Available, validation ongoing | Capacitance matrix from a field solver, selected with `--fastcap` |
| `KPEX/2.5D` | `CC` | Available, validation ongoing | Coupling capacitances between equipotential nets |
| `KPEX/2.5D` | `R` | Available, validation ongoing | Distributed resistance network |
| `KPEX/2.5D` | `RC` | Available, validation ongoing | Distributed resistances with coupling capacitances |
| `KPEX/FastHenry2` | `R`, `L` | Planned | No extraction command in the current release |
: Engine capabilities {#tbl-engine-status tbl-colwidths="[22,13,25,40]"}

`RC` includes coupling capacitances. There is no separate `RCC` value for `--mode`.
